summary: Tested Bitácora visual evidence + 'Al día' SLA normalization end to end (backend pytest 13/13; UI flows via Playwright). Every requested feature passed: form test ids present, Al día checkbox gating, preview/remove via input, Ctrl+V paste, drag&drop, .exe/>5MB toasts, max-5 toast, save with Al día -> badge + thumbnail, lightbox zoom/download, KPI fire test (En Gestión Crítico 310->309, Al día 5->6 after normalizing prj_560eaf4af410), plain-note regression and old 'Ver Correo' entries still render.

minor.issue: Orphan evidence: uploads that are never linked to an entry (failed bitacora POST, partial multi-upload failure, user abandons) remain in object storage + bitacora_evidence with entry_id=None forever. No cleanup/TTL and no DELETE endpoint.
Only checks authentication; no project-visibility check (any user with proyectos module read can fetch any project's evidence if they know the id). Low risk since ids are random.

Pre-existing RBAC: users with special_permission 'proyectos:create' but module level 'none' (e.g. kherrera) pass the middleware for ANY POST under /projects — they can upload evidence and add plain bitácora notes (verified: kherrera upload -> 200) even though GET /projects returns 403. Al día is correctly blocked (403 from handler).

issues: Fecha de Ejecución uses native <input type=date> (browser picker) instead of shadcn Calendar (pre-existing)
Some legacy entries without created_by_name render an empty author ('· 28/08/2026') e.g. [ACTUALIZACIÓN MASIVA DE ESTATUS] (pre-existing)
Zoom '100%' = container width, not natural image size; small screenshots are upscaled/blurry at 100%. Consider 'fit' vs real-size.

action_items: Optional: cleanup orphan bitacora_evidence (entry_id=None older than X h) or upload evidence in the same request as the entry
Optional: enforce project visibility in get_bitacora_evidence
Optional: review middleware override where 'proyectos:create' allows all POSTs under /projects
critical_code_review_comments: handleAddBitacora uploads files one by one before the entry. If upload N fails, uploads 1..N-1 are orphaned and a retry uploads them again (duplicates in storage).
addEvidenceFiles: when current+incoming > 5 it truncates silently to the remaining slots with a toast. OK, but the toast doesn't say how many were accepted.

sla_reset_at persists across later stage changes; correct because stage_entered_at is newer, but if a project goes back to En Gestión with an older unblocked_at the stale reset could still apply (edge case).
